update cere_product_sku set product_id = #{productId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, SKU = #{SKU,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, price = #{price,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, original_price = #{originalPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, stock_number = #{stockNumber,jdbcType=INTEGER}, total = #{total,jdbcType=INTEGER}, weight = #{weight,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, sku_image = #{skuImage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, `style` = #{style,jdbcType=BIT}, create_time = #{createTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_time = #{updateTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where sku_id = #{skuId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: SELECT ANY_VALUE(sku_name) as sku_name, name_code, ANY_VALUE(sku_id) as sku_id from cere_sku_name where sku_id in(SELECT sku_id from cere_product_sku where product_id = #{productId}) GROUP BY name_code

SELECT ANY_VALUE(sku_value) as sku_value, value_code from cere_sku_name where sku_id in(SELECT sku_id from cere_product_sku where product_id = #{productId}) and sku_name = #{skuName} GROUP BY value_code

SELECT ANY_VALUE(sku_name) as sku_name, ANY_VALUE(sku_value) as sku_value, value_code FROM cere_sku_name a LEFT JOIN cere_product_sku b ON a.sku_id = b.sku_id where b.product_id = #{productId} GROUP BY value_code
SELECT sku_value,value_code from cere_sku_name where sku_id=#{skuId}

SELECT b.shop_id, a.product_id, a.sku_id, b.product_name, b.if_huabei, a.original_price, a.weight, IF(d.image IS NULL OR d.image = '', c.product_image, d.image) image, a.stock_number, a.SKU, b.if_logistics, a.price from cere_product_sku a LEFT JOIN cere_shop_product b ON a.product_id = b.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, a.product_image from cere_product_image a, cere_shop_product b where a.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id) c ON b.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.sku_id, a.image from cere_sku_name a, cere_product_sku b where a.sku_id = b.sku_id GROUP BY a.sku_id) d ON a.sku_id = d.sku_id where a.sku_id = #{skuId}

SELECT a.shop_id, a.product_id, a.product_name, a.if_huabei, c.sku_id, c.original_price, a.if_logistics, c.weight, c.SKU, c.stock_number, IF(d.image IS NULL, b.product_image, d.image) image, c.price from cere_shop_product a LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, a.product_image from cere_product_image a, cere_shop_product b where a.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id) b ON b.product_id = a.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, a.sku_id, a.original_price, a.price, a.weight, a.stock_number, a.SKU from cere_product_sku a, cere_shop_product b where a.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id) c ON a.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.sku_id, a.image from cere_sku_name a, cere_product_sku b where a.sku_id = b.sku_id LIMIT 1) d ON c.sku_id = d.sku_id
where a.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT a.sku_id, a.stock_number, a.total, IF(d.image IS NULL, c.product_image, d.image) image, a.price as original_price, a.price, f.valueCodes from cere_product_sku a LEFT JOIN cere_shop_product b ON a.product_id = b.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_image) as product_image from cere_product_image a, cere_shop_product b where a.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id) c ON b.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.sku_id, ANY_VALUE(a.image) as image from cere_sku_name a, cere_product_sku b where a.sku_id = b.sku_id GROUP BY a.sku_id) d ON a.sku_id = d.sku_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(value_code) valueCodes, sku_id from cere_sku_name GROUP BY sku_id) f ON a.sku_id = f.sku_id where a.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT a.sku_id, a.stock_number, a.original_price, IF(d.image IS NULL, c.product_image, d.image) image, a.price, 0 as activityType from cere_product_sku a JOIN cere_shop_product b ON a.product_id = b.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, a.product_image FROM cere_product_image a JOIN cere_shop_product b ON a.product_id = b.product_id where a.product_id = 1 GROUP BY a.product_id) c ON b.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.sku_id, a.image FROM cere_sku_name a JOIN cere_product_sku b ON a.sku_id = b.sku_id where b.product_id = 1 GROUP BY a.sku_id) d ON a.sku_id = d.sku_id where a.product_id = #{productId}
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(value_code) from cere_sku_name where sku_id=#{skuId}
SELECT stock_number from cere_product_sku where sku_id=#{skuId}
SELECT a.number stockNumber,a.sku_id from cere_order_product a LEFT JOIN cere_product_sku b ON a.sku_id=b.sku_id LEFT JOIN cere_shop_product c ON b.product_id=c.product_id where a.order_id=#{orderId}

SELECT d.shop_id,a.product_id,a.sku_id,a.product_price*a.number total, a.product_price price,a.image,a.number,a.weight,a.SKU,c.`value`, a.product_name, a.logistics_price, b.pricing_price, a.activity_type, 0 as discout_price, a.actual_price from cere_order_product a LEFT JOIN cere_shop_order b ON a.order_id=b.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(sku_value) `value`,sku_id FROM cere_sku_name GROUP BY sku_id) c ON a.sku_id=c.sku_id LEFT JOIN cere_platform_shop d ON b.shop_id=d.shop_id where a.order_id=#{orderId}
SELECT sku_id,stock_number FROM cere_product_sku
select a.sku_id, a.price, group_concat(b.sku_value) as skuName from cere_product_sku a join cere_sku_name b on b.sku_id = a.sku_id where a.product_id = #{productId} group by a.sku_id
select product_id, sum(stock_number) as stockNumber, sum(total) as total from cere_product_sku where product_id = #{productId}
select product_id, stock_number, total from cere_product_sku where sku_id = #{skuId}
select sku_id from cere_product_sku where product_id = #{productId}

select a.* from cere_product_sku a join cere_sku_member_real_info b on b.sku_id = a.sku_id and b.activity_type = #{sceneType} and b.member_level_id = 0 join cere_shop_product c on b.product_id = c.product_id and c.shop_id = #{shopId} and c.shelve_state = 1
select sku_id, product_id, stock_number, total from cere_product_sku where product_id = #{productId}
